describe.label: Describe this paper
describe.prompt: Describe the selected paper: what it is about, the method and the main results, in a few sentences.

tags.label: Tags and keywords
tags.prompt: Suggest tags and keywords for the selected documents, using the tags of my taxonomy where they fit.

related.label: Find related documents
related.prompt: Find documents in my library related to the selected one and say why each is related.

readNext.label: What to read next
readNext.prompt: Based on what I have read and my projects, what should I read next? Give a short ordered list with reasons.

summarizeSelection.label: Summarize the selection
summarizeSelection.prompt: Summarize the selected documents together: common themes, differences and open questions.

updateProject.label: Update the project
updateProject.prompt: Update the notes of my current project with what is new in the selected documents, and propose documents to add.

whatsNew.label: Check what is new
whatsNew.prompt: Check what is new on the topics of my library since I last looked, and list the most relevant publications.

secondBrain.label: Export the second brain
secondBrain.prompt: Prepare an export of my library as a second brain: notes, links between documents and a summary of each topic.
